visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male presenter with glasses and a black shirt stands centrally against a clean white studio background featuring a light gray world map graphic. He gestures with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. Top banner reads "南極冰山斷裂 冰封多年海底終於曝光". (2) A satellite image of a snowy coastline representing Antarctica is overlaid on the screen with a yellow circle highlighting a specific offshore area. A NASA Worldview logo and the date "2025 JAN 19" are visible on an inset graphic. (3) The presenter returns to full frame, continuing his enthusiastic hand gestures and facial expressions. The background remains the same map-patterned studio wall. He uses his hands to emphasize the scale of the ice shelf. (4) An rectangular inset image appears showing white, tube-like marine organisms such as sponges and anemones clustered on dark rocks underwater. The top banner text updates to "200公尺冰層下竟藏蓬勃生命". (5) The inset image switches to show a large purple octopus with prominent suckers resting on a seabed of rocks and gravel. The presenter's hands are visible at the bottom of the frame gesturing while the image remains on screen. (6) The presenter is back to full frame, speaking with a contemplative expression. He continues gesturing as he discusses the scientific implications and potential environmental changes, maintaining eye contact with the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 南極冰山斷裂 冰封多年海底終於曝光. [Subtitle]: 話說你有想過冰層下. (2) [Subtitle]: 是什麼樣子嗎 今年年初 神秘的南極悄悄開箱. [Logo]: NASA WORLDVIEW. [Variety]: 2025 JAN 19. (3) [Subtitle]: 一座大約兩個台北市大的 巨型冰山 在冰架上斷裂. (4) [Subtitle]: 揭開了一片從未見過的海底世界 你猜猜這個被厚達 200 公尺的冰層蓋住. (5) [Subtitle]: 從來沒有陽光 也沒有食物的海底世界 會是什麼樣子呢. (6) [Subtitle]: 科研人員也很好奇 於是立刻派出水下偵測器. (7) [Subtitle]: SuBastian 潛入 230 公尺下的海底探險 結果發現一片死寂. (8) [Slogan]: 200 公尺冰層下竟藏蓬勃生命. [Subtitle]: 的相反 生態非常蓬勃啊. (9) [Subtitle]: 海綿海葵軟珊瑚等生物 密密麻麻的生長在岩石上 還有章魚水母在一旁穿梭. (10) [Subtitle]: 根本就是個熱鬧的秘密世界 而且研究者觀察後推測. (11) [Subtitle]: 有些生物可能已經在冰層下 生活了數十年 甚至上百年. (12) [Subtitle]: 他們連續好幾天操縱水下無人載具 ROV 來探索. (13) [Subtitle]: 繪製海底地圖 採集沈積物跟生物樣本 但預計要花好幾年時間. (14) [Subtitle]: 才能將新發現的物種一一描述發表 並弄清楚這些生物. (15) [Subtitle]: 到底怎麼在長久與世隔絕的環境中 存活下來. (16) [Subtitle]: 目前初步推測 可能是洋流把養分帶進來的. (17) [Subtitle]: 只是當冰層崩解 這些原本與世隔絕的生物 有辦法面對外界的變化嗎. (18) [Subtitle]: 欸 或許我們也該反過來問 我們有辦法面對他們嗎.
